title: Account Prioritization 1:1 Cheatsheet — Pruvia Health
content:
Meeting: weekly AE <> CSM 1:1 prep
Date/time: 2026-03-13 10:00am PT (30m)
Attendees: Riley (AE), Avery (CSM) — aim: sync on Pruvia health, prioritize asks for this quarter

Context / quick summary:
- Pruvia Health: mid-market payer-tech startup, live with Redwood hosted API for chat triage and embeddings since Nov 2025.
- Current spend: ~120k/mo (hosted + dedicated burst), steady growth but margins tightening.
- Renewal early-warning: contract renews 2026-09; expansion potential with new clinical workflow pilot.
- Technical issues last month: intermittent 503s on evening batch window (root cause suspected autoscaler config mismatch).

Primary objectives for this 1:1:
1) Reconfirm top account objectives and what success looks like this quarter (expansion $ & product milestones).
2) Prioritize support/eng requests so we don't overload SRE and to protect SLA.
3) Decide on next customer touch: technical design review vs exec business review.

Draft agenda (30m)
- 0-5m: Quick status + wins (Riley)
  - Pilot A completed tokenization tests; latency improved ~12% with continuous batching config.
- 5-12m: Risks & blockers (Avery)
  - Autoscaler errors: collect logs, confirm incident timeline, decide mitigation (scale-up policy vs temporary dedicated shard).
  - Data residency ask from compliance team: they want Private deployment eval — scope/ask?
- 12-22m: Prioritization exercise (together)
  - Rank these 4 asks: 1) Fix autoscaler, 2) Dedicated shard for peak hours, 3) Start Private eval for EU data, 4) Create cost-optimizer report + prompt evals.
- 22-28m: Next steps & owners
- 28-30m: Confirm ask for exec touchpoint and prep owner

Key prep notes / facts to surface in meeting:
- MRR trend: usage grew 18% MoM in Jan-Feb; 3 big spike days tied to marketing campaign (see Confluence PRUV-usage-weekly).
- Recent incident: 2026-02-26 23:10–23:45 UTC, ~1200 requests failed. Postmortem draft in linked_artifacts (JIRA-8124).
- Cost profile: 65% of spend is inference tokens, 20% pipeline/batching inefficiencies. Quick optimization could free ~15k/mo.
- Compliance: Pruvia legal requested Data Processing Agreement addendum for EU data on 2026-03-02.

Suggested talking points / scripts:
- On autoscaler: "We've prioritized reliability — my ask is we schedule an eng triage this week to confirm whether a temporary dedicated shard is needed during your evening batch window. Short-term ops will limit interruption while we root cause the autoscaling policy mismatch."
- On Private eval: "We can scope an EU Private pilot; first step is a compliance checklist and estimate (ops hours + infra). Would you like me to scope this and propose a timeline?"
- On cost optimization: "We ran a quick analysis — adopting prefix caching + a moderate quantization profile could cut inference unit costs without noticeable quality loss in triage flows. I can share a one-page with savings estimates."

Questions to ask Avery (CSM) / notes to capture live:
- Is the Pruvia procurement exec still the same (J. Martinez)? Any timeline changes?
- Which workflows are highest priority for SLA? (clinical triage vs billing match)
- Any internal champions for Private deployment ask? Who owns compliance?
- Would they accept a short dedicated shard for 8–11pm PT to stabilize evening batches?

Prioritization matrix (simple):
- Impact vs Effort quick scoring (1–5) — discuss and agree during meeting
  - Fix autoscaler: Impact 5, Effort 3
  - Dedicated shard: Impact 4, Effort 4
  - Private EU eval: Impact 3, Effort 5
  - Cost-optimizer report: Impact 3, Effort 2

Proposed next steps (assignments — fill in during 1:1)
- Riley: Draft scope for Private EU pilot (include hours + rough cost estimate). Due: 2026-03-20.
- Avery: Pull compliance contact name + availability; confirm procurement timeline. Due: 2026-03-16.
- Riley + SRE (Samir): Run fast autoscaler triage; collect metrics & logs, propose temporary remediation (dedicated shard or policy tweak). Target: 2026-03-17.
- Samir: Produce incident timeline and attach to JIRA-8124, tag Pruvia stakeholders. Due: 2026-03-13.
- Riley: One-pager cost-optimizer with estimated monthly savings and risks. Due: 2026-03-19.

Meeting follow-up template (for after 1:1) — copy/paste to Slack / email to stakeholders:
Subject: Pruvia 1:1 notes & action items (2026-03-13)
Body:
- Quick summary of decisions (autoscaler triage + temp dedicated shard agreed to explore)
- Action items with owners/due dates (list)
- Link to incident postmortem & cost analysis

Notes to self / open questions (scratch):
- If they push for Private, check legal cost allocation in enterprise playbook (confluence: private-deploy-costing).
- Confirm whether ded shard requires dedicated GPUs (or we can use reserved capacity burst).
- Remember to ask for a customer-facing CTO intro if exec review needed.

Tone/behaviour reminders for the call:
- Be concise — 30m only; lead with impact statements.
- Validate assumptions before promising timelines.
- Push for one clear next step (triage + scope) rather than a laundry list.

End of notes.
